name: Ioun Stone (Strength)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

text: Once you are attuned, toss this stone upward as a Magic action and it circles your head 1d3 feet away, granting its benefit while it orbits; snatching it back out of the air takes an action. The stones bear the name of Ioun, a deity of knowledge and prophecy worshipped on some worlds. Benefit: +2 Strength, to a maximum of 20.
